sub_questions.question: Can I use my own model (own provider/key or own custom/self-hosted model) with Dify?
Am I restricted to what's available in the Marketplace?

claims.claim: The customer cannot use their own model with Dify.
claims.guide_evidence: a workspace connects its **own** model provider

claims.claim: Users are limited to the providers listed in the Marketplace, i.e. OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI and the other officially published plugins.
claims.guide_evidence: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, and others are published officially; additional community providers are also listed

claims.claim: There is no way to bring a model that isn't one of the listed providers.
claims.guide_evidence: this guide does not enumerate which self-hosted runtimes currently have an official plugin

evaluation.rationale: The answer flatly says no, but the guide explains that a workspace can connect its own model provider and API key. The guide also says community providers are listed, and that self-hosted or local runtimes can be managed through a Marketplace plugin when one exists. The claim that nothing outside the official plugins can be used is not supported, since building custom integrations isn't covered in the guide and should go to a specialist team. The answer also never checks what Chidi means by "my own model".
